title: feat(studio): object field designer Tier-2 ergonomics
body:
## Summary
Tier-2 editing ergonomics for the object field designer — the "human makes simple modifications to AI-authored objects" path.

- **Default value** — a type-aware editor in the field inspector: tri-state select for boolean (— / True / False), number input for numeric, an option dropdown for single picklists, text otherwise. Omitted for computed / relational / media / structural types (no literal default). Persists on `Field.defaultValue`.
- **Duplicate field** — clones the selected field directly below itself with a collision-free name (`<name>_copy`, `_copy_2`, …) and a "(copy)" label, then selects the clone.
- **Keyboard reorder** — `Alt+↑/↓` on a focused field row swaps it with its nearest same-group neighbour (never crosses groups), reusing the existing reorder write path. A11y win for non-drag users.

All new strings localized (en-US / zh-CN).

## Tests
+11 RTL cases: default-value commit per kind, computed/lookup omit the editor, boolean uses a select; duplicate naming + selection + collision handling; Alt-arrow reorder + bounds + plain-arrow-noop + read-only inert. `metadata-admin` suite green (**97**); `tsc` clean; 0 lint errors.

## Not included (still open from the evaluation)
- Bulk multi-select of fields; conditional visibility; a full validation-rule editor — larger surfaces, deferred.
- Help text was intentionally skipped: the field model has no distinct inline-help property (only `description` + `placeholder`).

## Note
Live browser verification remains blocked by a local framework dev-backend auth issue (`/api/v1/auth/get-session` 404 → console SPA can't restore a session), unrelated to this change; covered by unit tests.
